title: Grateful Dead Live at San Diego International Sports Arena on 1973-11-14

ai_review.summary: Clean, bright soundboard capture of a strong ’73 Hollister show featuring a stellar China > Rider and an epic The Other One sandwich.
ai_review.review: The recording has been cleaned up and brightened, delivering a clear soundboard source despite some channel‑swap and pitch‑correction quirks. Musically the concert is praised for its standout second set – the China Cat Sunflower / I Know You Rider segue, multiple The Other One sandwiches, Eyes of the World, Big River and Wharf Rat – though one listener feels the band sounds a bit tired in places.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are 5‑star and detail both strong musical moments and solid (though not flawless) recording quality, giving a clear consensus of a high‑quality show with good technical presentation.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Cleaned up and brighter than older copies; channels are switched and several tracks need slight pitch correction, but overall the SBD is clear with minimal drop‑outs.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set flows brilliantly with tight segues and a memorable The Other One sandwich, while the first set has solid high‑points but occasional pacing lulls.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Angular, almost ’76‑style guitar on China Cat Sunflower; hot playing on Eyes of the World.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass shines during The Other One sandwiches (noted as ‘smoking’ alongside Bob).
band_member_comments.Bob: Strong vocal performance throughout, especially on Black Throated Wind, Truckin' and Saturday Night; his trademark “cat‑calling” highlighted.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s keyboards are tight, particularly in the latter part of Eyes of the World and on Brown‑Eyed Women.
